schedulingAssessment: read-heavy-07: Find schedule corruption around daylight-saving transitions

corruptionMechanisms.statement: Serialization stores no offset or zone and deserialization returns a naive datetime, making DST folds ambiguous.
Schedule uses a mutable list as a default argument, so tags can leak between instances.

clearedSuspects: clock.utc_now returns an aware UTC timestamp and is not the source of timezone erasure.
